items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The design tokens (theme.json), the finishes (finishes.json) and the roles that read them (lib/theme.ts).

items.name: theme-shadcn
items.title: Theme: shadcn neutral
items.description: shadcn's neutral palette and flat finishes as one more theme, installed into themes/shadcn/ (theme.json, finishes.json, index.ts) for `selectTheme` to switch to while the app runs.

items.name: theme-solid-glass
items.title: Theme: Solid Glass
items.description: Solid Glass (deeplethe/solid-glass, MIT) as one more theme: panes of thick smoky glass — a rim of light on each top edge, a hairline round it, a shadow underneath — installed into themes/solid-glass/ (theme.json, finishes.json, index.ts) for `selectTheme` to switch to while the app runs.

items.name: theme-default
items.title: Theme: NSH Gallery UI
items.description: The library's own theme (the build-time one) as one more theme, installed into themes/default/ (theme.json, finishes.json, index.ts) — what an app built on another theme switches back to with `selectTheme` while it runs.

items.name: press
items.title: Press
items.description: A press's feedback: the theme's sink and its ease.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The small tools the shells share: a look's value or accessor, the name a control gives screen readers, and how an app's part classes meet ours.

items.name: as-text
items.title: As text
items.description: A control's children drawn as its text: a string or number child in a Text, anything else as it is, where the control draws them.

items.name: switch-geometry
items.title: Switch geometry
items.description: A switch's sizes and the arithmetic of its knob.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The icon renderer: lucide's nodes on a canvas, and the check mark as an SVG.

items.name: color-format
items.title: Color format
items.description: A picked color written in each of the picker's formats, and the ink that reads on it.

items.name: popup
items.title: Popup
items.description: The popup families' surface, motion and mark, and the scrim behind what is modal.

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: Density, section surfaces, and list rows whose hover fill bleeds.

items.name: open-state
items.title: Open state
items.description: The controlled or uncontrolled open flag of a composition root.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A turning ring: work going on.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small capsule label in neutral, toned, or outline styles.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button, an icon button, a round button, and a split button.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch whose knob springs across a sunk track.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A card dialog: Trigger, Content, Title, Description, Footer and Close.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button, bare or outlined, with a label or an icon.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A sunk box that fills in citrus, with a check or a dash springing in.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A sunk ring that fills in citrus, with a dot growing in — alone or as a choice tile.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row or column of toggles on the inset toolbar track.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: An inset track of tools, with groups and hairline separators.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field — sunk, ghost, multiline, masked, or invalid.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A sunk number field with − / + or stacked chevron steppers.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time code cells that lift out of sunk wells as digits fill in.

items.name: time-field
items.title: Time Field
items.description: A sunk well for a time of day, one segment at a time.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A popover-coloured hint bubble on any element's tooltip prop.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A popup panel that grows from its trigger, on the shared menu surface.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card that grows from its trigger, on the shared popover surface.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen over a scrim.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A raised banner with a title, optional description, action and close.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A confirmation of the platform's own: shadcn's parts over the system's alert (AlertDialog.show).

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A menu of items, separators and submenus on the shared menu look.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu at the pointer, on the shared menu look.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: Shared list popup, rows, search and clear looks for select, combobox and date picker.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A list of choices from a field trigger, on the shared listbox look.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable field with a list of choices and chips for the values chosen, on the shared listbox look.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month of days to pick a date or a range, on the shared calendar look.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A calendar in a popup from a field trigger, on the shared listbox look.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A pill track or underlined row with a traveling indicator.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: A sunk track whose raised thumb springs to the selected segment.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: List rows that reveal panels with a turning chevron.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A disclosure row that reveals a panel beneath it.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Snapping slides with round arrows and a traveling dot pill.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A text link with underline motion, on the shared nav look.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A pager of page numbers and chevron arrows.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate or indeterminate progress bar.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A label above a value for metric grids.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A dot and label for quiet row or header state.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A sunk rail with a citrus fill and round thumb.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round picture or named initials on the identity ring.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: A card-styled spreadsheet with sorting, selection, and resize.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A composition table wearing the shared data-table classes.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A card-framed tree with chevron rows and folder icons.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command palette with search, groups, and shortcut keys.

items.name: scrollbar
items.title: Scrollbar
items.description: Hover-reveal scroll bars for scroll views and lists.

items.name: plot
items.title: Plot
items.description: Chart colors, grid, cross line and tooltip for nsh/base/plot.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resize handles with a quiet hairline and a growing thumb.

items.name: dock-area
items.title: DockArea
items.description: Dockable workspace chrome: tabs, splits, and edge docks.

items.name: diff-view
items.title: DiffView
items.description: Up/down tints for additions and deletions, with hunk actions.

items.name: text-view
items.title: TextView
items.description: Brand links and a streaming caret for Markdown documents.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji picker
items.description: Gallery look for nsh/base EmojiPicker: tabs, search, tones and preview.

items.name: rich-editor
items.title: Rich Editor
items.description: Rich document typography and its session API, on nsh/base's RichEditor.

items.name: code-editor
items.title: Code Editor
items.description: A code editor on the field's well, with line numbers and diagnostics.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: ColorPicker
items.description: Area, sliders, joined fields, swatches, and popover trigger.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A flat surface that groups related content: a header with its action, a body and a footer.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A set of fields under a legend: labels, descriptions, separators, and errors read out.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of a list: media before its content, a title with a note, and controls after it.

items.name: pressable
items.title: Pressable
items.description: A region that takes presses and adds only the feedback: hover, the press's sink, the focus ring.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline across the content, or down a row.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The shape of content that is still coming: a block in the theme’s accent fill that breathes.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key of a shortcut: a small cap in the muted fill, alone or in a group.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name of a control: a row whose text is the control labels’ own type.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A notice of the whole page or form, read out when it appears.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A centered block that says there is nothing here yet, and what to do about it.

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Buttons joined into one control, in a row or a column.

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: A field's frame around an input and what sits beside it — an icon, a unit, a button.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail from the app's root to the page it shows: links a chevron parts, the page itself last.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A box as wide as its column and as tall as its ratio says.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A field of several lines, in the look of the input.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel from the bottom edge, with a grabber, that a swipe closes.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus whose triggers stand in one bar.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A line in a conversation that is not a message: a status, a note, or a labeled separator.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: The framed surface of one turn of a conversation, and the reactions that hang off it.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One row of a conversation: the sender's avatar, who they are, the turn, and what is under it.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file, a picture or a link carried by a message: its media, its name, how it is doing, and what can be done to it.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: MessageScroller
items.description: A conversation that keeps up with itself: new turns follow the newest message while you are at the end, and wait when you are not.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: A row of triggers, each opening a panel of anything under the bar — one at a time.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app's navigation column: groups of rows, folded to a strip of icons or sliding in as a sheet on a phone.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A program's output on the theme's field surface, the keys typed back to it.

items.name: nav-stack
items.title: NavStack
items.description: Pages pushed on a stack: the themed header a desktop draws, the system one a phone shows.

items.name: split-view
items.title: SplitView
items.description: Columns of navigation stacks, with the column header and the sidebar button in the theme's look.
